subject: Commercial proposal: MAP, commitment & PO / billing questions
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jae Sato <j.sato@clearline.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial proposal: MAP, commitment & PO / billing questions

Hi Jae —

Thanks for the time on Friday. Attached is a draft mutual action plan (MAP) we put together to align milestones, commercial terms, and the expected close timeline for the Clearline evaluation and ramp. High-level summary below: 

- Commitment: 12-month commercial onramp after evaluation.
- Ramp profile: 3-month ramp (pilot -> staged production), target steady-state by month 4.
- Pricing: 10% enterprise discount applied to hosted usage for the 12-month term with agreed commit levels (details in sheet).
- Payment terms: propose Net60 for enterprise account on signed PO; standard Net30 for self-serve customers.
- Invoicing cadence: monthly in arrears; first invoice tied to pilot kickoff for reserved capacity (unless otherwise required by PO).

Questions for you:
1) Can Clearline accept Net60 on an issued PO?
2) Who in procurement should receive the invoice (email/address + PO format)?
3) Do you need billing to start at pilot kickoff or only at production go-live?

Attached: Clearline_MAP_v1.xlsx (milestones, pricing bands, commit table).

If you prefer, I can send an updated MAP that explicitly ties invoicing dates to milestones and includes mock invoice dates for your finance team to validate.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachment: Clearline_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24KB)
From: Jae Sato <j.sato@clearline.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial proposal: MAP, commitment & PO / billing questions

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the deck and the clear summary. A few quick items from procurement/finance: 

- Procurement prefers Net60 but we need the account team to confirm that on paper (our legal/finance signoff).
- Invoices should be addressed to: Clearline Corp, AP Dept — finance@clearline.io. We use a standard PO template (I attached it below).
- Billing start: internal preference is to begin invoicing at production go-live. For pilot costs we can accept a separate PO for reserved capacity if Redwood needs to invoice earlier, but it must be clearly called out and agreed by our ENG manager.

I also want to confirm how discounts are applied month-over-month if usage spikes above committed levels. Could you add a short section in the MAP that spells out overage handling and effective invoice line items?

I'll loop in procurement if we move forward — I expect internal approval within 10 business days once terms are final.

Thanks,
Jae
Head of Platform Partnerships, Clearline Corp
j.sato@clearline.io

Attachment: clearline_po_template.pdf (PDF, 18KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial proposal: MAP, commitment & PO / billing questions

Quick internal note — thoughts below before we update the MAP.

- Net60: acceptable for enterprise with 12-month commit and a signed PO. If procurement needs an initial 30-day exception for the pilot, we can do Net30 for the first invoice and Net60 thereafter, but keep it simple if possible.
- Discount / overage: offer 10% on committed baseline, bill overages at list price with crediting if sustained over three consecutive months (example clause in my note).
- Billing start: recommend pilot invoice be for reserved capacity (small fixed amount) so we can secure capacity and confirm CL billing pipeline. Production invoices start at go-live.

Action items for MAP v2:
1) Add explicit invoice schedule table (mock dates).
2) Add PO number field requirement and invoice email line.
3) Add overage handling example and sample invoice line items.

Ben
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jae Sato <j.sato@clearline.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial proposal: MAP, commitment & PO / billing questions

Hi Jae —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. I updated the MAP and attached v2 which explicitly ties invoices to milestones and includes a mock invoice schedule, PO field, and overage handling examples. Key adjustments: 

- Commitment: 12 months, 10% discount applied to committed baseline.
- Payment terms: Net60 on issued PO for the 12-month agreement. If Clearline prefers, we can accept Net30 for a single pilot invoice and Net60 thereafter (please confirm).
- Invoicing cadence: Monthly in arrears.
- Billing start: default to production go-live for volume-based billing; reserved capacity (pilot) will be invoiced as a fixed pilot charge at pilot kickoff if you issue a PO covering that charge.
- PO requirements: invoice must include PO number; send invoices to finance@clearline.io.

Related link: HubSpot deal with mock invoice dates -> https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/CL-2026-07-12-RED-01

Please see Clearline_MAP_v2.xlsx attached. If that aligns with procurement, we'll prepare the SOW and finance-ready invoice schedule and route for signature (DocuSign link included in the HubSpot notes).

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachment: Clearline_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 29KB)
From: Jae Sato <j.sato@clearline.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Team <finance@clearline.io>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial proposal: MAP, commitment & PO / billing questions

Monica —

This looks good; procurement is aligned on Net60 with the PO approach and the invoice schedule you outlined. Finance asked that we confirm: invoice to finance@clearline.io with PO number on each invoice, monthly in arrears. We will plan to issue the PO within two weeks. Production go-live is currently scheduled for 2026-07-26; finance expects billing to start on that date for volume-based charges.

One last ask: can you include a single-line summary of the pilot fixed charge (amount and billing date) on the final MAP so our AP team can match the PO? If you can return that by Thursday we'll circulate internally and return the PO.

Thanks,
Jae
